summary: Russian-controlled territory shrank by 18 km² between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-27, to 117,089 km² (19.4% of Ukraine). Source: DeepState geometry, independently measured here.
Contested or unconfirmed-status ground stands at 1,649 km² (-25 km² on the week).

changelog.text: The Ukrainian Armed Forces have regained control of the area near Zapadne.
The enemy occupied Markove and advanced near Fedorivka.
The Defense Forces of Ukraine cleared positions in the vicinity of Toretske.
The enemy has occupied Novooleksandrivka and has also advanced near Yurkivka and Vasylivka.
The enemy has advanced near Kalenyky.
The enemy has advanced near Bilytske.
The enemy has advanced near Nykyforivka.
The Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated Ridkodub, Nove and Katerynivka, and regained control of areas near Novomykhailivka and Lypove.
